title: Programming Language Setup
questionRule: Skip directly to Step 2 or Step 1. Not a theory validated topic.
expectation: Programming Language is not a theory validated topic. No conceptual or complexity questions are asked. Skip directly to Step 2 or Step 1.0.

title: 1.0 Introduction
questionRule: Ask as much as you can to gauge basic familiarity
expectation: Verify familiarity with C++ boilerplate, compilation, syntax, I/O, and variable fundamentals.

questions.title: What is the purpose of the main() function?
How do you print output in C++?
How do you read input in C++?
What is the difference between cin and cout?
What is the purpose of a semicolon?
How do you take multiple inputs in one line?
How do you declare a variable?
How do you initialize a variable?
What is the size of int in bytes?
What is the size of char in bytes?
What is the purpose of bool?
What values can a bool store?
What is the ASCII value of 'A' and 'a'?
Difference between single quotes ' ' and double quotes " "?
Difference between a variable and a constant?

title: 1.1 Data Types
hintRule: If needed, 1 or 2 hints based on student's logic & progress
passCriteria: Must solve at least 4 out of 5 correctly (4/5)
expectation: Candidate should be able to take input & print required output for all questions asked. If not solved, student needs to revisit '1.1 Data Types' and stop interaction.

questions.title: 1. Big Sum
questions.description: Read two integers that may be as large as 10^18. Print their sum. (Tests long long)

questions.title: 2. Float Equality
questions.description: Read three floating point numbers. Print YES if sum of first two equals third within tolerance 1e-6, else NO.

questions.title: 3. Shift the Letter
questions.description: Read a lowercase letter. Print the letter three positions ahead in the alphabet, wrapping around after z.

questions.title: 4. Division Trap
questions.description: Read two integers. Print their integer division result and true floating point division result on separate lines.

questions.title: 5. ASCII Neighbour
questions.description: Read a single character. Print its ASCII code and the character whose code is one greater.

questions.title: 6. Truthy Print
questions.description: Read an integer. Print 1 if non-zero and 0 otherwise, without using an if statement.

questions.title: 7. Fits in 32 Bits
questions.description: Read an integer. Print YES if it fits in a 32-bit signed integer range, else NO.

questions.title: 8. Three Roundings
questions.description: Read a floating point number. Print its floor, ceiling and nearest rounded value on separate lines.

questions.title: 9. Triple Product Overflow
questions.description: Read three integers, each up to 10^6. Print their product. (Tests overflow handling with long long)

questions.title: 10. Digit Character to Number
questions.description: Read a single digit character ('0'-'9'). Print twice its numeric value.

questions.title: 11. Mixed Sum
questions.description: Read one integer and one float. Print their sum correct to two decimal places.

questions.title: 12. Negative Remainder
questions.description: Read two integers where first may be negative. Print remainder when first is divided by second.

questions.title: 13. Long Factorial
questions.description: Read integer n (n <= 20). Print n factorial. (Requires long long)

questions.title: 14. Average of Three
questions.description: Read three integers. Print their average correct to two decimal places.

questions.title: 15. Char Sum
questions.description: Read two lowercase letters. Print the sum of their positions in alphabet (1-based: a=1, b=2... z=26).

questions.title: 16. Fits in Unsigned Integer Range
questions.description: Read an integer. Print YES if it fits in an unsigned integer range, else NO.

questions.title: 17. Boolean Subtraction / Addition
questions.description: Tell output: int a = true, b = false; cout << a - b; or int a = true, b = true; cout << (a + b);

questions.title: 18. Float Comparison Precision
questions.description: Tell output: float a = 6.753; if(a == 6.753) cout << "Yes"; else cout << "No"; (Tests float vs double literal promotion)

title: 1.2 If Else
questionRule: Pick any 2 (1 from theoretical reasoning, 1 from problem links)
hintRule: If needed, 1 or 2 hints based on student's logic & progress
passCriteria: Correct logic and implementation with proper explanation
expectation: Candidate should write correct if-else conditions with proper explanation. If unable to solve, revisit '1.2 If Else Conditions' and stop interaction.

questions.title: 1. Largest and Smallest of 4 Integers
questions.description: Given 4 integer values, find and print the largest and smallest value using only if-else.

questions.title: 2. FizzBuzz Logic
questions.description: Given integer N, print 'FizzBuzz' if divisible by both 3 and 5, 'Fizz' if divisible by 3, 'Buzz' if divisible by 5, else N.

questions.title: 3. Valid Triangle Classification
questions.description: Take 3 side lengths as input. First check if valid triangle (sum of any 2 > 3rd). If valid, classify as Equilateral, Isosceles, or Scalene. If not valid, print 'not valid'.

questions.title: 4. Loan Eligibility Checker
questions.description: Rules: age < 18 -> Rejected (Underage); income < 20000 -> Rejected (Low Income); credit_score < 600 -> Rejected (Poor Credit); credit 600-749 -> Approved Standard; credit >= 750: existing_loans > 2 -> Standard, else Premium.

questions.title: 5. Exam Result with Re-evaluation
questions.description: total_marks < 0 or > 300 -> Invalid Marks; attendance < 75 -> Debarred; marks < 105 -> Fail; marks 105-179 -> Fail (Backlog) if backlog > 0 else Pass; marks >= 180: Distinction if >= 270 else First Class.

questions.title: AtCoder ABC132_A: Fifty-Fifty
questions.description: Check if string of length 4 contains exactly two distinct characters occurring twice.

questions.title: Codeforces 4A: Watermelon
questions.description: Check if integer w can be split into two positive even integers.

questions.title: AtCoder ABC080_A: Parking
questions.description: Calculate minimum cost between hourly rate A*T and flat rate B.

questions.title: CodeChef FLOW017: Second Largest
questions.description: Find the second largest integer among three distinct integers.

title: 1.3 Loops
passCriteria: Correct loop bounds, termination condition, and step update
expectation: Candidate should write correct loop logic with proper explanation. If unable, revisit '1.3 Loops' and stop interaction.

questions.title: 1. Print 1 to N or N to 1
questions.description: Print numbers from 1 to N ascending, or N down to 1 descending.

questions.title: 2. Print 10 Table
questions.description: Print the multiplication table of a given number up to 10.

questions.title: 3. First K Even / Odd Numbers
questions.description: Print first K even or odd numbers with operations as K or 2*K.

questions.title: 4. Check if Number is Prime
questions.description: Given integer N, determine if it is a prime number (check divisors up to sqrt(N)).

questions.title: 5. Print Divisors of N
questions.description: Print all positive divisors of an integer N in increasing order.

questions.title: 6. Product from 1 to 20
questions.description: Compute the product of all integers from 1 to 20 (handling 64-bit integer overflow).

questions.title: 7. 0 to N Even Numbers without If-Else
questions.description: Print all even numbers from 0 to N by stepping loop counter by 2, without any if-else statement.

title: 2.0 Traversal & Arrays
questionRule: Pick any 2 loop questions + pick 1 array traversal problem
passCriteria: Write clean iteration and boundary checks without any hints
expectation: Candidate should write correct code with proper explanation. Revisit 'Traversal' if unable to solve.

questions.title: Largest Element in Array
questions.description: Find the maximum element in an array of size N.

questions.title: Smallest Element in Array
questions.description: Find the minimum element in an array of size N.

questions.title: Search Element in Array (Linear Search)
questions.description: Check whether element X exists in an array and return its index.

questions.title: Numbers with Even Number of Digits
questions.description: Given array of integers, return how many contain an even number of digits.

title: 3.0 Time & Space Complexity
hintRule: NO hints given (can encourage student). Explain manually using pen & paper.
expectation: Student should manually explain using pen & paper. In case of failure, suggest revisiting Time & Space Complexity on LaunchPad.

questions.title: Q1: Single Loop Sum
questions.description:
sum=0; for i=1 to n: sum += i;
Ops for n=10? TC: O(n), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Q2: Nested Loops n x n
questions.description:
for i=1 to n: for j=1 to n: print i, j;
Ops for n=5? TC: O(n^2), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Q3: First and Last Element
questions.description:
a = arr[0]; b = arr[n-1]; print a+b;
Ops for n=1000? TC: O(1), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Q4: Repeated Doubling Loop
questions.description:
i=1; while i < n: print i; i = i * 2;
Ops for n=16? TC: O(log n), SC: O(1)
questions.answer: 4 prints, TC: O(log n), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Q5: Dynamic Result Array
questions.description:
create array result of size n; for i=0 to n-1: result[i] = i*i;
TC: O(n), SC: O(n)

questions.title: Q6: Triangular Star Loop
questions.description:
for i=1 to n: for j=1 to i: print '*';
Ops for n=5? 1+2+3+4+5 = 15 = n(n+1)/2. TC: O(n^2), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Q7: Consecutive Single & Nested Loops
questions.description:
for i=1 to n: print i; then for i=1 to n: for j=1 to n: print i*j;
Total prints for n=4? 4 + 16 = 20. TC: O(n^2), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Q8: Outer Linear, Inner Logarithmic
questions.description:
for i=1 to n: j=1; while j < n: print i, j; j = j * 2;
Ops for n=8? 8 * 3 = 24. TC: O(n log n), SC: O(1)
questions.answer: 24 prints, TC: O(n log n), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Q9: Linear Recursion Stack
questions.description:
function f(n): if n==0: return 0; return n + f(n-1);
Calls for n=5? 6 calls. TC: O(n), SC: O(n)

questions.title: Q10: Outer Halving, Inner Linear Shrinking
questions.description:
i=n; while i >= 1: for j=1 to i: print j; i = i/2;
Ops for n=8? 8+4+2+1 = 15 = 2n-1. TC: O(n), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Adv Q1: Outer Doubling, Inner Linear to i
questions.description: for(i=1; i<=n; i*=2) for(j=1; j<=i; j++) count++; Value for n=16? TC: O(n), SC: O(1)

questions.title: Adv Q2: Harmonic Series Loop
questions.description:
for(i=1; i<=n; i++) for(j=1; j<=n; j+=i) print(j);
Prints for n=4? 4+2+2+1 = 9. Total = n * Hn. TC: O(n log n)

questions.title: Adv Q3: Divide & Conquer Recurrence
questions.description:
f(n): 2*f(n/2) + linear work print. T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n.
TC: O(n log n), SC: O(log n)
questions.answer: TC: O(n log n), SC: O(log n)

questions.title: Adv Q4: Repeated Square Root
questions.description:
i=n; while(i>2): i = sqrt(i); print(i);
Iterations for n=256? 256->16->4->2 (3 iterations). TC: O(log log n)

questions.title: Adv Q5: Recursion creating Array at each level
questions.description:
h(n): create array of size n, h(n-1). Cells for n=4? 4+3+2+1 = 10.
TC: O(n^2), SC: O(n^2) simultaneously on stack

title: 4.0 Pattern Questions
questionRule: Pick any 2 from CCBP pattern pool
hintRule: At most 1 or 2 hints based on student's logic
passCriteria: Explain logic on pen & paper and solve with at most 1-2 hints
expectation: Candidate should explain logic on pen & paper and solve. If unable, revisit 'Pattern Questions' and stop interaction.
